strategies.explanation: Context Tree - This model acts as a variable-order Markov chain, looking back dynamically depending on the detected market context (Context Tree Weighting approach). It operates with signal parameters such as max_suffix_len=5, lookback=500, threshold=0.66, fallback_mode=highest_prob, prob_gap_min=0.14. To control risk, it halts trading after 2 consecutive daily losses, restricts to 6 max trades per day, and sets a daily stop loss at 2 units. It dynamically stops trading after excessive continuous market streaks to avoid severe drawdowns. It avoids trading during highly dominant one-sided market periods (anti-chop mechanism).
